# Metacognitive State

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:MetacognitiveState`](gmeow-MetacognitiveState.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/MetacognitiveState>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/metacognition`](../../slices/metacognition.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An agent's intrinsic SECOND-ORDER mental moment — a state whose subject is one of the agent's OWN first-order mental moments or claims (a belief about a belief, a confidence about a confidence, an awareness of a gap in one's knowledge). The reflexive sibling of [`gmeow:CognitiveState`](gmeow-CognitiveState.md) (the knowing mode) and [`gmeow:IntentionalMode`](gmeow-IntentionalMode.md) (the conative mode), gathered under [`gmeow:MentalMoment`](gmeow-MentalMoment.md) (kernel) so an agent's whole mental life is queryable as one family ([Principle 15](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-15)). Inheres in exactly one agent. Its reflexivity edge is [`gmeow:metaTarget`](../properties/gmeow-metaTarget.md); its calibration rides [`gmeow:calibration`](../properties/gmeow-calibration.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:MentalMoment`](gmeow-MentalMoment.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:MetacognitiveState`](gmeow-MetacognitiveState.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:MentalMoment`](gmeow-MentalMoment.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Dunning Kruger

- **Source:** [`slices/core/metacognition/examples/dunning-kruger.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/metacognition/examples/dunning-kruger.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-metacognition-examples-dunning-kruger)#example-slices-core-metacognition-examples-dunning-kruger

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example — Dunning–Kruger as a MODELLED metacognitive miscalibration, the
# second-order companion to the cognition slice's dunning-kruger.ttl. Where that
# example records two coexisting first-order gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency claims at
# divergent depths (Principle 9), this one turns the reflexive lens on Sam's OWN
# self-assessment: a gmeow:MetacognitiveState whose gmeow:metaTarget is Sam's
# self-attributed mastery, carrying gmeow:calibration gmeow:overconfident. The
# numeric Brier-style gap rides gmeow:calibrationError — a SOLVER-LAYER annotation
# (Principle 12), invisible to the reasoner. The calibration is itself a
# vantage-indexed claim (Principle 9): the assessor judges Sam overconfident; GMEOW
# records the judgement, it does not adjudicate a global verdict.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/metacognition/> .
@prefix wd:    <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/> .

# --- Second-order: Sam's metacognitive state reflecting on that self-assessment.
#     metaTarget is the reflexivity edge onto Sam's own first-order proficiency
#     (the same-agent ownership is a SHACL concern, not an OWL axiom); calibration
#     reads the direction of the confidence/accuracy gap.
ex:samSelfRegard a gmeow:MetacognitiveState ;
    gmeow:metaTarget  ex:samQuantumSelf ;
    gmeow:calibration gmeow:overconfident .
```

### Reflection Revision

- **Source:** [`slices/core/metacognition/examples/reflection-revision.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/metacognition/examples/reflection-revision.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-metacognition-examples-reflection-revision)#example-slices-core-metacognition-examples-reflection-revision

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example — REFLECTION defeating one's own inference, belief revision as
# SUPPRESSION (Principle 10). The metacognition layer over the inference slice's
# belief-revision pattern: Lillith inductively concluded "the server is down" from
# "the ping timed out". On REFLECTION (a gmeow:Event typed gmeow:eventTypeReflection,
# tied to the reflexive layer by a gmeow:MetacognitiveState whose gmeow:metaTarget
# is her OWN gmeow:InferenceCommitment) she surfaces an UNDERCUTTING defeater — a
# firewall rule blocked the ping, removing the warrant. Revision does NOT delete:
# the conclusion-claim is set gmeow:displayable false, the gmeow:InferenceTenure is
# closed, and the gmeow:InferenceCommitment is retained as audit. The defeater is
# installed via the inference slice's gmeow:hasDefeater (reused by reference); the
# reflection → revision link is a documented bridge, never an axiom.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/metacognition/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

# --- The reflection act: Lillith reviews her OWN reasoning (the metacognition
#     layer). The event carries the gmeow:eventTypeReflection value; a
#     gmeow:MetacognitiveState ties the review to the reflexive layer, its
#     gmeow:metaTarget pointing at her own inference commitment.
ex:lillithReview a gmeow:Event ;
    gmeow:eventType gmeow:eventTypeReflection .
```

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:MentalMoment`](gmeow-MentalMoment.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to type an agent's second-order mental moment as a first-class state — a reflection on its own belief, confidence, knowledge, or its boundary — so metacognition is queried alongside the first-order doxastic, cognitive, and conative modes under [`gmeow:MentalMoment`](gmeow-MentalMoment.md) ([Principle 15](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-15)).

### Avoid when

- Avoid subsuming it under [`gmeow:CognitiveState`](gmeow-CognitiveState.md) (it is the reflexive sibling, not a kind of first-order knowing — [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)), avoid double-typing it as a [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) (the claim is the realisation, the state is the mode), and avoid it for a reasoning EPISODE that unfolds in time (that is a [`gmeow:MentalProcess`](gmeow-MentalProcess.md), mentation).

### How to use

- Mint one [`MetacognitiveState`](gmeow-MetacognitiveState.md) inhering in the agent; point [`gmeow:metaTarget`](../properties/gmeow-metaTarget.md) at the first-order state or claim it reflects upon, assign [`gmeow:calibration`](../properties/gmeow-calibration.md) when calibration is at stake, and realise the judgement as a [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) (vantage = the agent, [`observedFeature`](../properties/gmeow-observedFeature.md) = the agent's own state) when the vantage-indexed claim is itself the fact ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### Scope notes

- Sibling, not sub-mode (documentation only — no axiom): [`gmeow:MetacognitiveState`](gmeow-MetacognitiveState.md) is a co-equal child of [`gmeow:MentalMoment`](gmeow-MentalMoment.md), never an [rdfs:subClassOf](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subClassOf) [`gmeow:CognitiveState`](gmeow-CognitiveState.md). Subsuming it under the first-order knowing mode would erase the reflexive distinction (the [`gmeow:Question`](gmeow-Question.md) / [`gmeow:Proposition`](gmeow-Proposition.md) precedent). A metacognitive judgement is canonically realised as a [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) whose [`gmeow:vantage`](../properties/gmeow-vantage.md) is the agent and whose [`gmeow:observedFeature`](../properties/gmeow-observedFeature.md) is the agent's own first-order state — reuse, not new machinery ([Principle 6](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-6)).

### Examples

- ex:samDoubtsOwnGrasp a [`gmeow:MetacognitiveState`](gmeow-MetacognitiveState.md); [`gmeow:metaTarget`](../properties/gmeow-metaTarget.md) ex:samKnowsQuantum; [`gmeow:calibration`](../properties/gmeow-calibration.md) [`gmeow:overconfident`](../individuals/gmeow-overconfident.md).
